text.p: At least 17 people died in a fire that broke out at a hotel in central Istanbul early on Sunday, the state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
According to initial reports, 41 people were hurt in the blaze which began around 4.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) in a seven-storey, three star hotel in Istanbul's Laleli district.
Anatolian said mostly Ukranian tourists were staying in the hotel at the time.
The agency quoted unnamed officials as saying the fire may have been caused by a gas leak and that the number of deaths, caused mainly by smoke inhalation, may rise.
